mapper.select: SELECT sss.id, sss.title, sss.cover, sss.content, sss.summary, sss.create_time AS createTime, sss.scenic_spot_id AS scenicSpotId, sss.user_id AS userId, u.avatar, u.username, ss.title AS scenicSpotTitle, (SELECT COUNT(uao1.id) FROM user_action_operation uao1 WHERE uao1.type = 3 AND uao1.content_module = 'SCENIC_SPOT_STRATEGY' AND uao1.content_id = sss.id) AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(uao2.id) FROM user_action_operation uao2 WHERE uao2.type = 2 AND uao2.content_module = 'SCENIC_SPOT_STRATEGY' AND uao2.content_id = sss.id) AS upvoteCount, (SELECT COUNT(uao3.id) FROM user_action_operation uao3 WHERE uao3.type = 1 AND uao3.content_module = 'SCENIC_SPOT_STRATEGY' AND uao3.content_id = sss.id) AS collectionCount FROM scenic_spot_strategy sss LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = sss.user_id LEFT JOIN scenic_spot ss ON ss.id = sss.scenic_spot_id WHERE sss.id = #{id}
